dedupe_keys.name: haduk grid uk climate observations collection

description: HadUK-Grid, produced by the Met Office and distributed by CEDA, interpolates UK weather-station observations to 1-km grids and coarser grids or regional averages. Variables include rainfall, temperature, sunshine, humidity, pressure, wind and frost or snow indicators. Start dates vary, from monthly rainfall in 1836 to later twentieth-century series. The current annual collection reaches 2025, with provisional 2026 months available separately from the Met Office. Download access is free under OGL-UK-3.0. These observations can drive building-energy, water-balance and weather-exposure simulations and evaluate climate-adaptation scenarios. The collection succeeds UKCP09 observations and provides grids compatible with UKCP18 comparison scales. Resolution does not imply a weather station in every cell. Historical data rescue and annual reprocessing alter earlier values, while provisional months use fewer stations and incomplete quality control. Users must retain the version and distinguish provisional inputs from the annual release.
